title: docs(skills): objectstack-ai names what replaces the retired agent keys
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLCo5F2y7fgbM8tstGoyyUn)_

Fixes #37419

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：靠这份 AI 技能文档工作的助手，遇到已下线的两个智能体配置项时，能说出该改用哪两个配置项、工具该登记在哪里。
- 为什么做：技能评测跟进项。第 5 题带技能原本 0/5，补了两行文档后四轮都达标，最近一轮 5/5。第 6 题按您的第二次裁决恢复主线原样，改由另一张卡处理（让判分接受几种写法中的任意一种），在那之前它仍约半数误判。
- 出错会怎样：只改文档两行、示例删一行，运行行为不变；撤回这一个改动即可恢复。
- 要你做什么：技能文档属受管文件，合并需要 os-zhuang 批准。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the retired-keys table (2 rows): the `agent.tools` row now says where the tools go (a `defineSkill` under the stack's `skills`); the `agent.knowledge` row names the two keys that restrict retrieval on the knowledge source (`aiExposed`, `source.where`). Both come from the saved phase-2 patch, applied by hand.
- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the skill example: one sample instruction line removed ("Escalated cases must summarise the actions already taken."). This is the whole payment for the two rows: on the base this PR was written on, the rows alone took the file to 6813 tokens against a 6801 ceiling (over by 12), and with the line gone it measured 6797 (4 under). `main` has since lowered the file and its row twice (6801, then 6800, then 6799); on the current head the file measures 6795 against `main`'s 6799, the same 4 under. The other trims of the saved patch are not applied: the ratchet does not need them.
- The human-in-the-loop paragraph is not touched: it reads exactly as on `main` (ruling 7208935788, execution item 2; second ruling 7217332972, item 5).
- `skills/objectstack-ai/evals/skills-tools-knowledge.json` is not in this PR any more. Under the second ruling on the card (7217332972, option A, 「A 先上第5题,第6题另开卡」) case 6 is back at `main`'s bytes: `git diff origin/main HEAD` for that file is empty. Case 6 moved to #37928 (the skill-evals grader gains an any-of form over literal tokens, and case 6 is graded with it).
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: the ceiling row for `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` is lowered from 6799 (the value on `main`) to 6795, the file's measurement on this head. `main` reds a row left above its measurement, so the 4 tokens the trim over-paid are banked in the row. A lowering, not a raise; no other row moves, and the two notes `main` wrote above the row stay as they landed.
- `.changeset/37419-ai-skill-tombstone-replacements.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch. Its paragraph on case 6 is removed.
- Head `5b486c62` is `239d73bd` plus one commit: the eval file restored from `main` and the changeset paragraph removed (2 files, +1 / -3). `main` was not merged again: since `0a3ea67c` (already inside this head) `main` has moved 4 commits to `73d5e347`, none of them in `skills/`, the ratchet script or this PR's changeset, and a trial merge of `73d5e347` is clean with the same `skills/` tree and the same ratchet script as this head. So the ratchet reading on this head is the reading on the merged tree.
- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` is the same blob on `239d73bd` and on `5b486c62` (`3215031f`): `git diff 239d73bd 5b486c62` for that file is empty. The skill text the `239d73bd` round read is the text on this head.

### Skills size readings

| reading | before (`main` `73d5e347`) | after (`5b486c62`) |
|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, lines | 487 | 486 |
| `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, tokens of ceiling (ratchet) | 6799 of 6799 | 6795 of 6795 |
| all `skills/*/SKILL.md`, lines | 4959 | 4958 |
| authored bundle, tokens of ceilings (ratchet) | 199689 of 199689 | 199685 of 199685 |
| whole shipped tree, tokens | 301286 | 301282 |

Net lines across `skills/**`: +2 / -3 = -1 (budget: at most +3). The `main` column was measured on `0a3ea67c`; `main` has not changed `skills/` or the ratchet script since.

## Tests

Acceptance, narrowed to case 5 by the second ruling (7217332972, item 3): the round on `239d73bd` (dev report 7217136306), 5 draws per arm. Scratch worktree at the pushed head, eval file trimmed locally to ids 5 and 6 (uncommitted); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios skill-evals --skills objectstack-ai --repeats 5`. Driver: claude-code-cli 2.1.332, subscription login, the login's default tier, CLI default effort, `--max-turns 16`, 2 at once. 20 of 20 turns ran; none invalid or errored. No new round is owed on `5b486c62`: `SKILL.md` is byte-identical to `239d73bd` (item 2 of the ruling's execution).

| case | with skill | no skill | tokens missed (with skill) | bar | met |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5 | 5/5 | 0/5 | none | with skill at least 4/5 | yes |

Case 5 with the skill on the three earlier rounds since the two rows: 4/5, 4/5, 4/5. The case-6 rates of the same rounds stay recorded on the card (report 7217136306) and belong to #37928.

No behaviour pinned by a unit test changed, so no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- `overlap-check --branch=claude/area-o1B-37419` at `5b486c62`: `main` (`73d5e347`) merges cleanly; PR 37661 (shares `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`) and PR 37919 (shares `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) merge cleanly by text. PR 36158 is reported as conflicting in `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (exit 1); its head (`937e2f14`) conflicts with `main` alone in the same six regions of that file, none of them this PR's row, so the conflict is not this PR's.
- The branch of card 37782 (`claude/area-o1B-37782` at `46fb6638`, no PR open yet; it corrects a paragraph in the same `SKILL.md`) merges with this head cleanly by text. The row is pinned at the measurement (headroom 0), so whichever of the two lands second merges `main` and re-measures the ratchet row.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the two rows of the retired-keys table: check `aiExposed` and `source.where` against the knowledge-source table higher in the same file.
2. `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the skill example: one instruction line gone, nothing else.
3. `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, the one row: 6799 to 6795 and its note.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`; expect exit 0 and the line "skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md is 6795 tokens (ceiling 6795; headroom 0)".

- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "67 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)".

- Check-runs on `5b486c62`: 29 success, 16 skipped, none failed.
- At `86f70f00`: `check:skill-examples` exit 0, "352 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)". Not re-run on this head; CI's `Lint · docs & code guards` and `Type Check · source gates` are green on it.
